response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded, with a CS degree and genuine high-throughput distributed systems exposure (Sociomantic/dunnhumby low-latency services). However, the resume shows essentially no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis and bias detection. Scope is also mismatched — the track record is individual product/team delivery and craftsmanship advocacy rather than principal-level, multi-workstream architecture influencing many teams at enterprise scale. Strong generalist, but a weak fit for a Principal/IC6 growth-experimentation systems role without significant ramp-up.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on across many stacks; CS degree; polyglot (TS, C/C++, Java, C#, D)
Real high-scale, low-latency distributed systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby
Strong testing/quality culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source test tooling, teaching and talks
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging or growth-measurement platform experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or data-driven decision systems
Scope and leadership signals are team-level (Senior/Staff), not Principal/IC6 cross-org architecture and influence

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope gap versus Principal IC6 expectations
Deep, long-tenured polyglot engineering and distributed-systems fundamentals
